label: local-m4-narrowed
mix: one sheet, 100,000 rows: A = n, B = A*2 on every row, C1 = SUM(B1:B100000) (200,001 cells, stored with id references); open = Book::open; edit = set A50000 and answer the changed displays (Book::set), the first edit after open; next = set A50001 (graphs already built). Native release build, one thread, no network, no Yjs.
change: Book::set reads back only the cells the edit can change (crates/oc-sheet/src/deps.rs: opencalc's precedents, transitively; volatile, INDIRECT/OFFSET, names, open ranges and 3-D references always read; everything while a spilled array exists) and the workbook recalculates incrementally after open (automatic mode) instead of in full.

before.sameLoad: the previous engine.rs, same machine and load, same bench: open 274/277/283 ms, edit 103/104/104 ms, next edit 104/104/103 ms

notes: The first edit builds both dependency graphs (opencalc's and the block's); later edits pay only the recalculation of what changed (here the 100,000-cell SUM) and the reads of the 3 changed cells. Three runs, taken before the owner asked for one run per bench.
